is_mcmc.question: Are these draws from a genuine MCMC fit?

hmc_warnings.question: Are there post-warmup divergences, low BFMI or other unresolved HMC warnings?

stationary.question: Do independently initialized chains plausibly explore the same stationary distribution?

rhat_pass.question: Do all relevant rank-normalized/folded R-hat values pass the registry screen?

ess_pass.question: Are bulk and tail ESS sufficient for relevant quantities?

mcse_pass.question: Is estimand-specific MCSE below the scientific precision budget?

other_inference.action: Use inference-method-specific accuracy checks; fake chains do not validate VI/Laplace or optimization.

ask_method.action: Inspect how the draws were produced and whether chain axes represent independent runs.

ask_sampler.action: Inspect inference method and sampler metadata.

get_sampler.action: Extract warnings, divergences, treedepth and per-chain BFMI/energy where available.

geometry.action: Localize warnings in parameter space; check scaling, identification and parameterization before tuning. Route divergences separately.

get_plots.action: Inspect trace/rank plots and chain-wise scales/modes; preserve chain identity.

get_rhat.action: Compute rank-normalized split/folded R-hat for parameters and scientific derived quantities.

get_mcse.action: Define tolerable numerical error and compute mean/quantile/probability MCSE.

inspect_chains.action: Distinguish transients/slow mixing from separated modes, scaling, weak identification and geometry. Extend only after stable improvement is evidenced.

precision_or_geometry.action: If stationarity/geometry are sound and ESS grows with draws, add independent useful computation; otherwise repair mixing/geometry. Recheck tails and estimands.

next_ppc.action: Computational screens passed for the supplied quantities; proceed to targeted PPC and sensitivity. This is not model adequacy.

data_support_valid.question: Have likelihood support, transforms, indexing and data errors been checked?

geometry_localized.question: Have divergence-marked pairs and hierarchical/dependence geometry been inspected?

identification_sound.question: Is identification adequate for the intended quantities?

reparameterization_reviewed.question: Has a probability-preserving parameterization appropriate to the data information been considered?

tuning_plausible.question: After geometry review, is smaller integration error a plausible remaining mechanism?

other_checks.action: Zero observed divergences passes this screen only; inspect R-hat/ESS/MCSE, BFMI and PPC.

get_flags.action: Extract post-warmup divergent flags and chain counts; distinguish adaptation warnings.

check_support.action: Audit the generative implementation before modifying sampler settings.

fix_implementation.action: Correct justified data/model implementation errors, then refit.

inspect_scales.action: Inspect predictor/outcome units and positive scale transformations.

rescale.action: Rescale inputs/parameters with correctly transformed priors and predictions; refit.

inspect_geometry.action: Mark divergent transitions in pairs/parallel plots and inspect funnels, curvature, dependence and boundaries.

check_identification.action: Inspect scientific identification and ridge/scale symmetries; use simulation and informed domain constraints.

reformulate.action: Revise unidentified structure or justified priors; explain induced predictions and limits.

reparameterize.action: Consider centered/noncentered or other probability-preserving transforms based on information/geometry; verify the induced prior.

tune_then_check.action: Try bounded sampler tuning; record efficiency/treedepth and rerun all computational checks. An acceptance target alone does not resolve bias.

structural_review.action: Reassess geometry/identification, prior scales, likelihood structure or alternative inference; do not keep escalating adapt_delta blindly.

plausibility_targets.question: Are external/domain observable and derived-quantity plausibility targets defined?

generator_correct.question: Does simulation correctly implement the model, design and observation process?

prior_predictions_plausible.question: Are support, scales, tails and group variation plausible under the joint prior?

prior_cause.question: Does failure localize to justified revisable prior scales/dependence?

elicit.action: Elicit plausible quantities/intervals at representative design points and groups.

audit_generator.action: Check links, units, transforms, indexing, exposure and censoring before changing priors.

fix_generator.action: Repair the simulator/model implementation and resimulate.

simulate_checks.action: Simulate prior outcomes and scientific derived/group quantities against specified plausibility targets.

localize.action: Inspect induced parameter/observable scales and conditional group structure to locate the mechanism.

revise_priors.action: Revise defensible prior family/scales/dependence and document elicitation rationale.

revise_model.action: Revise scientifically implausible support/link/hierarchy or observation mechanism.

fit.action: Prior predictions pass specified plausibility checks; fit and validate computation.

ppc.title: Choose and respond to targeted PPC

computation_adequate.question: Is computation adequate for the quantities used in predictions?

targeted_quantities.question: Do checks expose specific plausible failures, including relevant dependence/groups?

observation_replication_correct.question: Does replication reproduce design, measurement/censoring and prediction conditioning?

ppc_features_adequate.question: Are the checked features adequate for the scientific task?

repair_computation.action: Resolve computation before substantive interpretation of PPC discrepancies.

validate_computation.action: Check sampler warnings, chain behavior, R-hat/ESS and predictive-quantity MCSE.

choose_quantities.action: Choose location/spread/tails/zeros/groups/dependence or scientific contrasts that reveal the suspected failure.

audit_replication.action: Verify outcomes versus expected responses, new versus existing groups and the observation process.

fix_replication.action: Correct the predictive simulation before revising the likelihood.

inspect_ppc.action: Compute/plot the specified checks with observed reference features and relevant uncertainty.

model_revision.action: Localize systematic failure and revise justified likelihood/link/dependence/hierarchy; document the mechanism.

next_sensitivity.action: These features show no identified failure; check sensitivity and unresolved scientific assumptions. Good PPC does not prove correctness.

using_power_scaling.question: Is sensitivity being approximated by power-scaling importance sampling?

density_components_valid.question: Are selected density components, transformations and alpha targets valid?

refits_valid.question: Have all alternative refits passed computation and matched estimand checks?

change_exceeds_mcse.question: Is the observed change distinguishable from Monte Carlo error?

practically_material.question: Does sensitivity materially affect the scientific conclusion?

check_base.action: Validate base diagnostics and estimands before sensitivity.

choose_method.action: Choose justified refit alternatives or valid local power perturbations; they answer different questions.

fix_densities.action: Correct the selected density/parameter measure and confirm proper targets.

audit_densities.action: Specify prior versus likelihood factors and hierarchy level; do not use lp__ as prior.

refit.action: Use explicit justified refits when importance overlap is unreliable; validate every fit.

check_weights.action: Inspect PSIS Pareto-k, weight concentration and MC precision at each used alpha.

validate_refits.action: Check each refit computation, PPC and the same scientific quantities.

improve_precision.action: The change is unresolved at current numerical precision; improve useful computation or report the limit.

estimate_precision.action: Compute MCSE of compared quantities and scientific tolerance.

define_tolerance.action: State which magnitudes or decisions would change the scientific conclusion.

investigate_mechanism.action: Distinguish intended prior information, weak likelihood, potential conflict and model misfit; inspect direction and corroborate local IS findings by refits.

report_local_robustness.action: Report tested alternatives/components/range and precision; local insensitivity is not universal robustness.

target_compatible.question: Are predictive target, held-out unit, information and likelihood measure compatible?

candidate_criticism_done.question: Have candidate models received targeted criticism and relevant inadequacies been acknowledged?

pareto_reliable.question: Do pointwise Pareto/precision diagnostics support PSIS for this target?

influence_examined.question: Have high-k units been checked for data errors, model misfit and target issues?

moment_matching_supported.question: Is valid moment matching supported by the model adapter/callbacks?

difference_uncertainty_examined.question: Are paired ELPD uncertainty, unit influence and search/dependence limits assessed?

define_target.action: Define target and align normalized unit contributions; use group/time/explicit folds if needed.

repair_computation.action: Repair computation before using predictive scores.

criticize_candidates.action: Run targeted PPC/sensitivity and acknowledge remaining failures; relative performance does not establish adequacy.

compute_pointwise.action: Compute pointwise LOO, k and precision; retain observation IDs.

inspect_influence.action: Inspect valid influential units and likelihood/model/target mechanisms; do not silently omit them.

verify_adapter.action: Verify unconstrained-density callbacks/Jacobians or official model support.

repair_and_recheck.action: Try moment matching; rerun k/precision. Refit unresolved units or use folds; model changes require their own scientific evidence.

exact_refit_or_folds.action: Refit leave-out posteriors or use scientifically appropriate folds, with computational validation.

inspect_differences.action: Inspect paired pointwise differences, SE and practical utility; account for dependence/search.

make_predictive_decision.action: Choose an adequate useful prediction strategy or stacking mixture using uncertainty and costs; critique mixture predictions.

scientific_target_defined.question: Are the scientific question, estimand and design/observation process defined?

prior_checked.question: Have induced prior predictions passed scientifically targeted checks?

computation_adequate.question: Has computation been validated for relevant quantities?

ppc_done.question: Have targeted PPCs been assessed and failures addressed/acknowledged?

sensitivity_done.question: Has relevant prior/likelihood sensitivity been checked with reliable estimators?

comparison_useful.question: Would predictive comparison inform the scientific decision?

comparison_valid.question: Have target, reliability, uncertainty and candidate criticism gates been completed?

define_science.action: Inspect model/code/data and define estimands, units, information and identification limits.

prior_route.action: Run prior plausibility/elicitation; simulation/implementation changes return here.

mcmc_route.action: Run method-appropriate computation checks; failures return to geometry/model/implementation as diagnosed.

ppc_route.action: Choose targeted predictive failures and replicate the actual observation process.

sensitivity_route.action: Compare scientifically relevant alternatives/components with precision and reliability gates.

decide_comparison.action: State whether selecting/combining predictive strategies helps the scientific task; it is optional.

comparison_route.action: Define target/units, inspect pointwise PSIS or folds and paired uncertainty, then make a practical decision.

report.action: Report claims, assumptions, uncertainty and limitations; keep the model-development record and reproducible evidence. No checklist proves scientific correctness.
